corrections.issue: A rotate command was prepared with an invalid parameter shape.
corrections.action: The pending command was abandoned, the known-good checkpoint was retained, and no geometry mutation was claimed.

corrections.issue: Default curve conversion produced 1308 vertices and 1316 faces.
corrections.action: The result was rejected as needlessly dense and the runtime gained an explicit set_curve_resolution operation.

corrections.issue: Resolution 3 / bevel resolution 2 passed topology checks but looked faceted.
corrections.action: It was visually rejected; resolution 6 / bevel resolution 2 was accepted at 440 vertices and 444 faces.

corrections.issue: The transfer Blender process reported an Intel driver access violation after saving.
corrections.action: The report and saved artifact were retained only as bounded evidence; the crash is not represented as a modeling failure or silently omitted.
